thread:
nina: Quick question— baby ETA in early Aug. planning to start leave a few days before and take 10 weeks after. What exact forms do I need to file, and when to avoid payroll delays?

omar: Congrats! :tada: Short checklist: 1) Submit parental leave in the HR portal ASAP (we ask for ~30 days notice). 2) If eligible, submit FMLA (or local equivalent) for job protection. 3) File STD claim with the insurer after you have the due date. 4) Add dependent on benefits within 30 days.

lisa: Payroll details: to have company-paid top-up included on expected pay, get leave request + STD confirmation submitted at least 10 business days before payroll cutoff. Cutoff is the 1st of each month for that month's payroll. If you miss it, payment will process next cycle. Company top-up: primary caregivers get 8w at 100% salary; non-primary 4w.

nina: Do I need a physician note before filing STD?

omar: STD usually needs physician's certification with the due date. You can submit the leave request before that, but file the STD form as soon as you have the doc to avoid delays. For adoption, upload placement docs instead.
